objective: Implement exact-byte retained artifact staging and independent later rehash, with a strict manifest declaring build inputs and retention identity. Do not assume reproducible build, provenance signature, or remote immutable store until separately evidenced.
nonGoals: No rebuild-on-promotion, no publishing, no production deployment
No new default hosted workflow or unsigned provenance presented as signed attestation
No write outside the explicit caller-provided local retention directory
decisions: Content-addressed filenames and no replace/overwrite for retained bytes; later consumers must read the original and rehash.
Store manifest and bytes in a caller-owned directory; future externally controlled immutable retention and signed provenance must independently qualify.

obligations.description: Reject symlink/oversize/tampered/archive substitutions and duplicate conflicting store identities.
Return only retained existing bytes after verifying SHA and identity; never execute a build on promotion.
A valid local manifest does not authenticate SLSA builder, toolchain, action pins or independent retention custody.

structure: src/sf/retained_artifact.py: local byte-addressed stage/open with fsync and no overwrite
tests/test_retained_artifact.py: idempotency, mutation and retention error cases
impact: Independent local candidate artifact store module; no effect on previous preview interfaces

budget.network: No external publisher or artifact server
budget.execution: Stable candidate once; no redundant CI

externalEffects: Only local test filesystem writes and stacked branch changes; no production store modification or publication
